thesis: RingCentral reported Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-22 and raised its full-year outlook: Q3 total revenue $676M (+5.9%), non-GAAP EPS $1.33 vs $1.13 a year earlier, free cash flow $157M (+21%), and full-year 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $4.96-$5.10 and free cash flow of $615-$625M; the stock is up 23% over 60 days. After a post-earnings high of 98.14 on 2026-10-23 it has retraced about 13% to 85.64, which suggests part of the move has already been given back. Strongest counter-case: the book-value ratio is deeply negative (P/B -583.7), pointing to a leveraged balance sheet, and revenue growth is only about 6%. Cash generation and the raised guidance argue against balance-sheet stress, but this run did not verify the debt maturity schedule, so the counter-case is not fully resolved and conviction is held at medium. No scheduled ruling or hearing was found (a Jan 2026 law-firm announcement of a shareholder investigation has no filed case or date), and no restatement, auditor change, equity offering or C-suite departure was found; an Aug 2026 CFO share sale is noted but is not a departure.
invalidation: next quarter guidance walked back, or free cash flow growth stalls while leverage rises
